notes: This inventory identifies prior completed archives that can be reopened for QuickPLS 2.55 presentation evidence without rerunning their scientific engines.
Schema-5 archives expose a result/run ID rather than a schema-6 canonical result-document ID.
Prior screenshots establish historical completion but are not accepted as current QuickPLS 2.55 UI evidence; every reusable entry therefore requires a new current-UI capture.
Every static archive source is bound to its exact lowercase SHA-256 digest; current-candidate screenshots and receipts remain runtime evidence rather than inventory declarations.
coverage_routes is the exact presentation-evidence plan. Each declared result family appears once for its public method and is bound to one truthful current Results observation.
The MGA source records zero omitted observations, so its excluded-row ledger is intentionally empty and must be presented as an empty ledger rather than invented row identities.
The five exact-fit presentation states are render-contract evidence for PLS bootstrap and are not frozen archive result families.
Every static inventory and coverage-route archive is curated under validation/fixtures/v255/archives so a committed clean checkout contains the exact declared bytes.

known_current_evidence_gaps.description: The inventory declares exact capture contracts, but no historical screenshot is accepted as a final QuickPLS 2.55 observation. Each route still requires a passed current-candidate Results capture and fresh-reopen receipt.

The posthoc method has no reusable completed archive. Its posthoc_supplement route must bind a newly completed packaged result, exact archive SHA-256, direct result identity, fresh-process reopen receipt, and current UI observations.

These dynamic named_supplement routes intentionally omit static identity fields. The crawler must bind each route to the corresponding passed current named-case report entry, its generated archive and SHA-256, scientific identity, and current UI observations.

Schema-5 archives frequently store an engine method such as pls_pm rather than the public Calculate kind. The 2.55 evidence receipt must bind the exact public kind to the selected archived result without relabelling scientific identity.
